calls.video_title: Why Is SoFi Stock Crashing, and is it a Generational Buying Opportunity?
calls.thesis: First tracked Parkevtate SOFI call — BUY / 'buying opportunity' (he upgraded at ~$18 earlier). Stock down 12% in a month, -46% YTD on higher rates; forward P/E 18.5; sees >24% upside over 12-18 months to his $19 fair value. Above-average risk.
calls.base_case: Lending segment booming (Q2 segment revenue +63% YoY) with strong third-party loan demand.
calls.bear_case: Higher rates cut the fair value of its $46.6bn loan book (likely billions), default rates rising (personal loans 4.57%->4.77% Mar-Jun) and likely up again; consumer/macro headwinds worsening.
